title: Cost Recommendation Sentinel and Safe-Rollback Protocol for Latency-Sensitive Optimizations
creator: Liam Chen
description: Build a "sentinel" component that wraps automated batching/cache recommendations and ensures safe application and rapid rollback of config changes when latency or throughput SLOs degrade. The sentinel will provide: (1) pre-apply risk scoring for a proposed batching/caching profile, (2) a staged apply that enforces concurrency/throughput limiters and SLO-aware routing to isolate traffic, (3) continuous anomaly detection that triggers automated or operator-confirmed rollback, and (4) clear audit/logging hooks for post-incident analysis. This ticket scopes the runtime control-plane integration, the routing policy changes, the anomaly detectors and thresholds, and the operator UI + API for override and incident notes. Goal: enable the cost recommender to safely pursue >15% token-cost reduction for synthetic/steady workloads while keeping p95 latency regressions <5% and p99 <10% compared to baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel evaluates every recommended config and emits a risk score with rationale and estimated perf impact
Staged apply supports percent-based ramp (0,1,5,20,100) with enforcement of concurrency and micro-batch caps
SLO-aware router routes only low-latency-tolerant traffic to experimental pool; high-priority traffic always stays on baseline
Anomaly detector triggers automated rollback within 60s of a confirmed p95 or error-rate regression breach
Operator can force a rollback or pin configs via Console with audit logging preserved
Telemetry dashboards show cost delta, per-route latency distribution, and rollout state for each recommendation

implementation_notes: Risk scoring will combine three signals: historical rollout delta, static heuristics (e.g., max_batch_size), and real-time traffic shape mismatch detection
Staged apply controller is implemented as a control-plane job that annotates routing rules and enrolls a fraction of tokens via tag-based routing
Limiters implemented at the worker agent: micro-batch cap, concurrent-requests cap, and token-per-second cap per pool
Anomaly detection uses configurable windows (30s/2m/10m) and two detectors: EWMA for drift, and a seasonal-aware changepoint detector for abrupt regressions
Operator overrides store notes and require a two-person signoff for manual full-population applies for P1 recommendations
qa_plan: Unit tests for risk scorer with edge cases (no history, conflicting signals)
Staging integration: run the recommender against sampled traffic and assert sentinel blocks >90% of high-risk configs
Canary: rollout to internal dev org first; monitor p95, p99, errors, and cost delta over 72h
Failure injection: simulate worker slowdown and verify automated rollback within 60s
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - internal dev: enable sentinel with dry-run mode and UI visibility (1 week)
Phase 1 - beta customers: allow non-critical routes opt-in with 5% ramp, close monitoring (2 weeks)
Phase 2 - broad opt-in: increase to 20% ramp with automated rollback enabled; require audit annotations for all recommendations
Phase 3 - default-on for eligible routes with gradual expansion and telemetry retention extended
notes: Design decision: use tag-based routing rather than per-request header mutation to simplify downstream SDK changes
Open item: define the exact taxonomy of 'high-priority' vs 'low-latency-tolerant' traffic with Product
Follow-up: schedule a post-rollout evaluation to measure realized cost savings and incidence of false rollbacks
